blocks.title:
Fair question.
Here is the honest table.
blocks.sub: Sometimes you should hire. Sometimes a freelancer is right. This page says when, including when it is not us.

blocks.title: Four ways to get the work done.
aside: The last column is us; the other three are fair

rows: After the statement of work and the bench
Days, if you find the right one
One person, as good as their last job
Named senior engineers you interview first
We manage the person; you direct the work
Yours on payment, in your repo from day one
Four hours with GMT, every day, the same four
Salary, taxes, equipment, recruiter fee, ramp-up
Day rate; no cover when they are ill
Day rate; cover and holidays handled; no recruiter fee
The work is permanent and core
You need forty people and a programme office
Three to twelve months of senior capacity, measured
Engineers and months. The total is the total.

21 working days a month. No onboarding fee, no recruiter fee, no notice-period buyout. Compare it with a hire: salary plus employer taxes, equipment, a recruiter fee and the months before the first commit.

At [YOUR RATE] a day · invoiced monthly in arrears
NET 14 · 30 days’ notice, either side

items.a: When the work is permanent and core to the product, and you can wait for the right person. We will say so on the call; we would rather lose the engagement than have you rent what you should own.

items.q: When is a big outsourcer right?
items.a: When you need forty people, a programme office and someone to blame. We are not that, and we do not pretend to be.
A fortnight of specialist work with a clear end. For three months or more, the cover, the review and the handover start to matter, and that is where we come in.

items.q: Can we convert an engineer to a hire later?
items.a: Yes. After six months there is no fee; before that, one month of the day rate. We would rather you had the person than a clause.

blocks.title: If the table says hire, we will say so too.
blocks.sub: Bring the problem, not a brief. If it is outside what we do well, we will say which of our contacts to call instead.
blocks.emailLine: Or email [HELLO@HOPSIG.COM] — reply within one working day.
